opening.argument: The offer is presented as a reported consumer promotion grounded in the speaker’s own experience: a free Dunkin’ coffee and a free $5 gift card. The steps are plainly explained: register on the app for a free drink, use the code BONUS when signing in for the gift card, and download the app and provide information. The branded Dunkin’ cup reinforces that the discussion concerns an identifiable retail promotion, while the app is also described as providing coupons usable with the gift card. Although viewers are asked to register and submit information, the available evidence frames those actions as requirements for advertised benefits, not as an attempt to obtain money or impose unrelated obligations. The separate subscription request is not tied to eligibility for the Dunkin’ benefits.

citations.quote: This week, I got myself a free coffee and a free $5 gift card from Dunkin Donuts.
if you use the code BONUS whenever you sign in, you get a free $5 gift card
All you have to do is download the app and fill out your information
